Propose the change set with the reduced capsule.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_gRDnMuJcM1fuTNFEYMIb6441","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural DurableWorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): DurableWorkflowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"Idempotency-Key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing Idempotency-Key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const child = call(\"greet\", {});\n    return Response.text(child.body);\n  });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":26199,"completion_tokens":823,"total_tokens":27022,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":23552},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":460},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":23552,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":2647},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
